title: Ford Torino Engines by Year (1968–1976)
description: Every factory engine in the Ford Torino, Torino GT, Cobra and Gran Torino by year, 1968–1976: the 302 and 351, 390, 428 and 429 Cobra Jets, and the 460.
intro: Ford's intermediate went from FE big blocks to the 385-series 429 and 460 in its nine years. The Fairlane shared the Torino's engines through 1970 and is included in those years' tables.
Pick a year to see every engine offered that model year, with its code, rated horsepower and the trims it came in. Each engine links to its full specs.
The 428 Cobra Jet was standard in the 1969 Cobra, and for 1970 the 429 came in Thunder Jet, Cobra Jet and Super Cobra Jet form.
The 1972 redesign put the Torino on a separate frame. Ratings from 1972 are SAE net. The 351 Cobra Jet lasted through 1974, and the 460 was offered from 1974.

method: Every engine and year listed here was confirmed by at least three independent sources: the NHRA Stock Car Classification Guides, factory material such as GM Heritage Center information kits and sales brochures, EPA records and established references. Several Wikipedia articles count as one source. Where sources give different ratings, the factory figure is shown and the difference is noted. Factory race-only packages need two sources.
